definitions.explanation: The time and energy required to do something.

examples.japanese: {手間|てま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It's a dish that takes a lot of effort to make.

examples.japanese: {手間|てま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{省|はぶ}く→省く：02398_habuku⟧⟦ために→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I use a machine to save time and effort.

examples.japanese: お{手間|てま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}らせて→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ありません→申し訳ない：20352_moushiwakenai⟧。

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {手間|てま}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧ (to take time and effort)
- {手間|てま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{省|はぶ}く→省く：02398_habuku⟧ (to save effort, to cut corners)
- {手間|てま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{惜|お}しまない→惜しむ：09610_oshimu⟧ (to spare no effort)
- お{手間|てま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}らせる→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to cause trouble - polite)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{手間|てま}{暇|ひま}→手間暇：22440_temahima⟧ (time and effort)
- {手間|てま}⟦{賃|ちん}→賃：noentry⟧ (labor charge, fee for work)
- ⟦{二度|にど}→二度：09503_nido⟧{手間|でま} (double work, having to do something twice)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {手間|てま}: Time and labor (neutral)
- ⟦{面倒|めんどう}→面倒：03809_mendou⟧: Trouble, bother (often implies annoyance)
